about_the_game:
First of all: Thank you to everyone who is part of the Elements Divided community, we are overwhelmed by your dedication to our game! In order to celebrate this, we have decided to launch a Supporter Pack which contains the following:

SUPPORTER PACK

Includes 22 new cosmetics, such as shaders, equipables, and new full body characters!

  • Full Body Characters

    • War Mech

    • Anubis

    • Evil God

    • Mysterium

  • Equipables

    • Hats

      • Gladiator Helmet Headgear

      • Samurai Helmet Headgear

      • Dragon Head Headgear

    • Facial Features

      • Hero Eyes

      • Warrior Eyes

      • Sharp Smile Mouth

      • Tongue Out Mouth

    • Back

      • Pet Elfie Back

      • Pet Harold Back

      • Pet Ramses Back

      • Pet Tyrus Back

      • Robo Spider Back

      • Evil God Back

    • Body Parts

      • Jester Mesh Arms 

      • Jester Mesh Legs 

      • Jester Mesh Torso

  • 4 new shaders

    • Rainbow

    • Critical

    • Regent

    • Valor

See you on the elemental battlefield!

/Loco Motion Devs
